## ScanMaster 1.0.0 — Full Document Scanning, Editing & Folder Organization

ScanMaster 1.0.0 brings a complete local-first document scanning, image enhancement, and PDF management workflow to Android.

### Highlights

- **Multi-page scanning with Auto & Manual modes:** Scrollable thumbnail strip for unlimited pages, per-page removal, gallery import, and a 3-second countdown auto-shutter.
- **Interactive page editor:** Per-page filter selection (*Original*, *B&W*, *Magic*, *Text*, *Sepia*), 90° page rotation, margin cropping, brightness/contrast adjustment sliders, and drag-and-drop page reordering.
- **Complete folder & file management:** Dedicated *Home*, *Folders*, and *Recents* tabs, folder creation/editing/deletion, moving documents between folders, and scanning directly into a folder.
- **Enhanced search & storage hygiene:** Tappable search results with multi-match highlighting, persistent recent searches, automatic cleanup of temporary raw captures, and a new adaptive app icon.

### Install

Download the `ScanMaster-*.apk` attached below to install or update ScanMaster on your Android device.
